title: [RM-903] Add public route metrics endpoint
author: LuisLopez97
body:
Adds a read-only endpoint that returns route revenue metrics.

Linear: https://linear.app/reservamos/issue/RM-903
derived_from: Composed from two real backend finding types: dropped provider/deleted_at scoping in get_queryset (security/data-leak, like the provider-scoping convention) + new endpoint shipped without any test (test_coverage). Two blocking findings -> requires a terse top-level comment.
